title: oxybaphus nyctagineus
intro: Oxybaphus nyctagineus, commonly known as Night-blooming Catchfly, is a plant species in the Four O'clock family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Oxybaphus nyctagineus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
